title: Immunogenicity and Safety of AdimFlu-S 2011-2012 in Non-Elderly Adult and Elderly Subjects
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the antibody response to each of the three influenza vaccine strains included in the licensed seasonal flu vaccine, as measured by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) at 21 days post immunization in non-elderly and elderly subjects in compliance with the requirements of the current European Union (EU) recommendations for the evaluation of the immunogenicity for a new formulation of a licensed flu vaccine (CPMP/BWP/214/96).
